summary: Frontend-only verification of Slovak text edits and new rotating testimonials on Soľ & Pec. All 7 request items PASS. Hero subline reads 'A dym, ktorý vonia celou ulicou.' (no 'voňá'); H1 lines are 'Chuť' / 'z pece' / 'na drevo.' with no 'Kuchyňa'; paragraph contains 'rebrá celý deň dusia na dreve'. Filozofia paragraph contains 'ale v ohni, v soli a v čase.'; 'prepásenej' absent. 'Svadobný koláč z našej pekárne' not present on / nor /eventy-a-svadby. Home events bullet list has exactly 2 items: 'Sál pri peci pre 40 hostí' and 'Menu z dreva, nie z katalógu'. Footer reads exactly 'Rodinná reštaurácia v Bratislave.' on / and /eventy-a-svadby. Testimonials: data-testid='testimonials-section' present; initial testimonial-0 shows Katarína B. (text uppercased via CSS); exactly 3 dots render with active (first) dot width 32px vs 6px for inactive; after ~6.5s auto-advanced to testimonial-1 (Martin a Lucia, svadba), after another ~6s to testimonial-2 (Peter H., stály hosť), then wrapped back to testimonial-0; clicking testimonial-dot-2 immediately shows testimonial-2 with Peter H. Reservation modal opens via header-reserve-button. Zero console errors on /.
critical_code_review_comments: Testimonials useEffect dependency [i] causes interval to be cleared/recreated on every change — functionally fine (always 6s between slides) but unnecessary; dependency array could be [] for cleaner intent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Attribution text in Testimonials is uppercased via Tailwind 'uppercase' class — when asserting via inner_text, compare case-insensitively (e.g. 'KATARÍNA B.' is correct). Interval is 6000ms; use ~6.5s waits for auto-advance assertions.
